title: VisitLogBook
description: Schema for a document in the 'VisitLogBook' collection. Records a volunteer's outreach visit log (earlier iOS/Android version).

uid.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the volunteer who created this log.

timestamp.description: The timestamp when the log was created. Represents a Firestore Timestamp.

whenVisit.description: The date/time of the outreach visit. Represents a Firestore Timestamp.

whereVisit.description: Description of where the outreach visit took place.

durationHours.description: Duration of the visit in hours.

durationMinutes.description: Duration of the visit in minutes (0–59).

peopleHelped.description: Number of people helped during the visit.

rating.description: Volunteer's self-reported rating of the visit (1–5).

otherNotes.description: General free-text notes about the visit.

volunteerAgain.description: Indicates if the volunteer would go again (0 = no, 1 = yes).

foodAndDrinks.description: Whether food and drinks were distributed.

hygine.description: Whether hygiene items were distributed. (Note: field name has a typo in the app.)

other.description: Whether other types of support were provided.
